pages.text: Stable release for Minecraft 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2.77 or newer, and Java 25.$(br2)$(li)Corrected salt generation settings and added the growthcraft:salt_generation world rule.$(li)Apple and grape fruit drop produce only at full maturity; apple spawning respects the ticked leaf and local population limits.

pages.title: Barrel Controls
pages.text: $(li)Standard and large fermentation barrels share one manual stop/start setting, disabled by default.$(li)Improved yeast feedback and book hints.$(li)Fixed top-hopper yeast insertion on large fermentation barrels.$(li)Migrated the previous large-barrel setting while preserving its command alias.

pages.title: Barrel Displays
pages.text: $(li)Storage barrels show four sequential 32-bucket gauges and an exact total.$(li)Barrel tooltips separate fluid names and volumes and show fermentation state without a seconds countdown.$(li)Corrected dark-band texture alignment on large barrels.

pages.title: Barrel Recipes
pages.text: $(li)Standard fermentation barrel recipes are unchanged.$(li)Large fermentation barrels use two matching standard barrels, three planks, and four iron nuggets.$(li)Storage barrels use three matching standard barrels, two logs or stems, and four iron nuggets.$(li)Added crafting entries and book hints for all wood variants.

pages.title: Barrel Fluid Limits
pages.text: $(li)The growthcraft:barrel_temperature_limit world rule defaults to 573 K.$(li)The config provides a server-wide ceiling, defaulting to 2147483647 K.$(li)A blocked-fluid tag can reject additional fluids.$(li)Existing contents remain drainable.$(br2)See $(l:server_settings/barrel_fluids)Barrel Fluid Restrictions$().

pages.title: 26.1.2.0.rc6
pages.text: $(li)Apple fruit now spawns only beneath the randomly ticked leaf, preserving local population limits.$(li)Breaking apple or grape fruit yields produce only at full maturity.
26.1.2.0.rc3$(br)Third UAT candidate for the Growthcraft Minecraft 26.1.2 port.

pages.title: 26.1.2.0.rc3
pages.text: $(li)Addressed Day 2 UAT findings across machine lifecycles, interfaces, JEI integration, and release metadata.
26.1.2.0.rc2$(br)Second UAT candidate for the Growthcraft Minecraft 26.1.2 port.

pages.title: 26.1.2.0.rc2
pages.text: $(li)Resolved Day 1 UAT issues across apples, machines, tooltips, and wood tags.$(li)Restored Brew Kettle rendering and lid behavior.$(li)Added JEI fluid hotkeys across Growthcraft machine screens.
1.21.1.7$(br)Current stable release for the Growthcraft 1.21.1 line.
$(li)Completed the stable 1.21.1 gameplay and compatibility fixes used as the 26.1 port baseline.$(li)Retained the in-game manual as the primary gameplay reference.
